thread:
maria: quick note: short-seq 2k bench shows ~12-15ms host-side delay before decode now, baseline was ~6ms.
aj: did you run with the grpc windowing patch?
maria: yes. flamegraph points at parse/tokenize path.
kevin: paste flame snippet? could be writev churn or protobuf memcpy.
maria: flamegraph: host_parse(13ms): grpc/frame_unwrap 4.2ms; proto::DeserializeRequest 3.7ms; utf8_normalize 2.6ms; tokenizer::encode_batch 2.5ms.
olga: looks like gRPC frame reassembly + lots of small writes. HTTP2 header overhead for tiny streams adds up.
aj: also check KV cache hit rate; variable-length prefixes from tokenizer can thrash hotset.
maria: kvcache hit drops 98%->90% under the short-seq pattern.
kevin: allocation churn?
maria: pprof heap: 120k tokenizer::encode_buffer, 50k proto::TmpBuf, 30k grpc::slice.
kevin: suggests per-request buffers; reuse per-thread scratch and collapse writes into one writev.
aj: kernel choice might matter too: small-seq kernels change batch shapes and increase host preproc fraction.
maria: pinned kernel to fast-smallseq-v2: host overhead down to ~9-10ms, kvcache hit up to 95%.
olga: partial. still ~3-4ms above baseline. ingress chunker likely flushing tiny frames; it sends on 512B or newline so short prompts cause flushes.
aj: propose adaptive chunker: coalesce small frames up to X ms unless route latency SLO forbids. floor header flush so one writev contains proto+body. route-configurable X.
kevin: plan: (1) per-thread encoder reuse, (2) single writev per request, (3) adaptive chunker with SLO override.
maria: I'll prototype 1+2 today. who owns heuristics?
olga: I'll design heuristics + rollout canary. sketching: default coalesce 5ms, max 20ms for low-priority routes, disable for realtime routes.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/host-preproc-coalesce v1 -> canary cluster in 30m.
maria: will attach microbench. expect 3-7ms win for short seqs and better kvcache locality.
aj: add telemetry: frames_per_request, avg_writev_count, kvcache_hit_by_route.
kevin: add regression test with jittered tiny writes; last fix hurt large-batch throughput.
maria: opening PR and will link perf runs. thanks :thumbsup:
